name: pixiv-browser
description: Search, rank, inspect, and preview public illustrations from the official Pixiv website.

interface.longDescription: Searches Pixiv's official website, ranks public illustrations by bookmark count, filters Pixiv-declared AI works, opens artwork details, and previews thumbnails. No Pixiv password or third-party proxy API is used.
defaultPrompt: Search Pixiv for illustrations of a character.
Show details for a Pixiv artwork ID.
